title.rendered: Nwabali returns to Chippa United five months after departure

content.rendered:
Super Eagles goalkeeper Stanley Nwabali has returned to South African club Chippa United ahead of the 2026/27 season, five months after leaving the side.

The 30-year-old rejoins the Chilli Boys after spending several months away from competitive football following his departure from the club in February 2026, a period that affected his place in Nigeria’s senior national team.

Chippa United announced Nwabali’s return on Sunday via its official social media channels.

“Chippa United Football Club is delighted to welcome @nwabali32 back to the Chilli Boys,” the club posted.

In a follow-up statement, the club added, “After taking time away, Stanley Nwabali returns to the Eastern Cape, and we are pleased to welcome him back to the club.”

Nwabali joined Chippa United in 2022 and rose to prominence after his impressive performances for Nigeria at the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations in Cote d’Ivoire, where the Super Eagles finished as runners-up.

His absence from club football in recent months, however, affected his regular playing time and saw him lose his place in the national team.

The goalkeeper will now hope to revive his career with consistent first-team football at Chippa United as he seeks to reclaim his spot in the Super Eagles ahead of upcoming international competitions.
